source: KEBA, KeContact P30 Modbus TCP Programmers Guide, V 1.07 (en), 12.2025

sources.title: KeContact P30 Modbus TCP Programmers Guide

notes: The interface needs a P30 c-series with firmware 3.10.16 or later, or a P30 x-series with software 1.11 or later. DIP switch DSW1.3 on the station must be ON to enable Modbus TCP. The guide says Modbus TCP and the UDP interface must not be used together.

The guide says the Unit ID must be 255, that only function codes 3 (read) and 6 (write) are supported, and that registers cannot be read in blocks: each value is read on its own, at most 2 registers (one 32-bit value). Registers are numbered from 0 (address_base 0), although the guide adds that some clients need +1.

Every readable value is a 32-bit unsigned integer in two registers. The guide does not state the word order; big (high word first) is assumed. Check against the display or the serial number if a value looks wrong.
Write registers hold one 16-bit value, are write-only (the guide marks them wo) and cannot be read back. The guide recommends reading no faster than every 0.5 s and writing no faster than every 5 s.

Firmware version (1018) is hex-coded in the decimal value (30A0D00 hex is 3.10.14); it has no firmware role because the raw value is not a version string. The guide notes that Modbus TCP version 1.11 numbers this register 1013.

Product type and features (1016) is a decimal number whose digits give the product type, cable or socket, maximum current, series, meter type and RFID; the digit tables are in the guide. Error code (1006) is a decimal number to be read as hex: the leading hex digit is the error group.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.

cable_state.7: Cable at station and vehicle, locked

registers.name: Error code
registers.description: 0 is no error; otherwise read the decimal value as hex

registers.name: Product type and features
registers.description: Decimal digits for type, cable or socket, current, series, meter and RFID; see the guide

registers.name: Firmware version
registers.description: Hex-coded: read the decimal value as hex, one byte per version part

registers.name: Maximum supported current
registers.description: Hardware limit: lowest of DIP switch, cable coding and temperature limit; socket models show 6 A with no cable plugged

registers.name: RFID card
registers.description: First 4 bytes of the card UID, when the session was authorized by RFID

registers.name: Failsafe current setting
registers.description: Active setting, not necessarily the persisted one

registers.name: Failsafe timeout setting
registers.description: Active setting, not necessarily the persisted one

registers.name: Set charging current
registers.description: Raw value in mA; lasts until the next reboot

registers.name: Set energy limit
registers.description: Ends the current or next session once this energy is delivered

registers.name: Failsafe current
registers.description: Raw value in mA: 0 stops charging, otherwise 6000 to 32000. Only active once a failsafe timeout is sent

registers.name: Failsafe persist
registers.description: Write 1 to store the failsafe settings

registers.name: Phase switch source select
registers.description: Chooses the channel that drives contact x2
